bio.heading: A physician's breadth, a diabetologist's depth
paragraphs: Dr. Sravanthi J is a Consultant Physician at Medicover Hospitals, Hitech City, Hyderabad, with more than 22 years of practice spanning internal medicine, diabetology and child health. Her work centres on getting the diagnosis right first, then building a treatment plan that fits the patient's daily life.

Alongside diabetes care, she takes a special interest in women's health, adolescent medicine, preventive care, and the management of medical conditions during pregnancy — areas where careful, coordinated physician-led care makes a lasting difference.
bio.philosophy: Good medicine starts with clear communication. Dr. Sravanthi explains every condition in plain language, so patients understand what is happening in their body and can follow their treatment plan with confidence.
bio.languagesNote: Consultations in English, Telugu and Hindi.

faqs.a: The consultation fee is ₹600 at the Medicover Out Patient Center, HITEC City. Fees for laboratory tests or procedures, if advised, are separate.
Monday to Saturday, 12:00 PM to 7:00 PM, at the Medicover Out Patient Center, HUDA Techno Enclave, HITEC City, Hyderabad.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Use the booking form on this page, call 040-68334455, or message on WhatsApp at +91 70754 93806. Once you book, the clinic team confirms your slot with a call.

faqs.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
faqs.a: Any previous medical reports, a list of the medicines you currently take, and your recent test results — including your latest HbA1c report if you have diabetes.

faqs.q: Can I consult for a second opinion?
faqs.a: Yes. Bring your existing reports, prescriptions and test results so they can be reviewed properly before any change to your treatment is discussed.

faqs.q: Which conditions does Dr. Sravanthi treat?
faqs.a: As an internal-medicine physician with a focus on diabetology, she manages diabetes, hypertension, thyroid disorders, obesity and lifestyle disorders, infections and fevers, anaemia and vitamin deficiencies, women's health concerns, and medical conditions during pregnancy, among others.

faqs.q: How is diabetes managed over the long term?
faqs.a: Diabetes care is individualised. It usually combines regular monitoring, medicines or insulin where needed, and practical diet and lifestyle guidance. The aim is steady, sustainable control — reviewed at follow-up visits and adjusted as your needs change.

faqs.q: I have blood pressure and thyroid problems along with diabetes. Do I need separate specialists?
faqs.a: Often, no. These conditions frequently occur together and affect one another. As a physician trained across internal medicine, Dr. Sravanthi manages them within a single, coordinated treatment plan — and refers you to a specialist when a specific condition needs one.
Yes. Dr. Sravanthi has a special interest in medical disorders during pregnancy — such as diabetes, thyroid problems and high blood pressure — and works alongside your obstetrician to manage them.

faqs.q: Which languages does the doctor speak?
faqs.a: Consultations are available in English, Telugu and Hindi.
